description.value: Saint Germain Bakery is an award-winning Canadian bakery chain founded in the mid-1980s, with pastry techniques drawn from top chefs in France, Japan, Hong Kong, and Australia. This location sits inside Richmond Centre mall and is part of a chain that has won multiple gold medals at the Culinary Olympics and international chocolate competitions. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond will find a reliable stop for fresh pastries, cakes, and baked goods.

address.value: Unit 2000, 6060 Minoru Boulevard, Richmond, British Columbia, V6Y 2B6

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces, covered) at 24m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 73m. Total: 8 spaces.
